title: Convergent active-passive cutover choreography and continuous restore validation harness
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement a convergent choreography for active->passive region cutover that preserves SLOs, exercises circuit breakers and load-shedding policies, and adds an automated continuous restore validation harness to guarantee backup integrity across region promotions. This ticket consolidates runbook steps, verification automation, and drill cadence into a single operable artifact that on-call and SREs can execute or schedule.
acceptance_criteria: A runnable cutover playbook that can be executed from the Console runbooks UI or via CLI with clear stakeholders and step timeouts
Automated restore validator that rehydrates a snapshot into an isolated test cluster and verifies tokenstore and KV consistency within 10 minutes
SLO-preservation checks that assert 95th p99 latency degradations are within agreed guardrails during staged cutover
Circuit breaker and load-shedding policies trigger and recover automatically during synthetic overload scenarios
Drill run results are captured to the DR dashboard and produce a post-mortem artifact linked to the ticket
runbook_steps: Pre-checks: verify latest snapshots exist for tokenstore/kv/meta in both regions; snapshot age < 24h; run quick checksum
Notify: alert stakeholders (SRE, on-call, PM, infra) via PagerDuty and #drills channel; set maintenance flag in Console
Read-only switchover: route 10% traffic to passive as a canary; monitor SLOs and error budgets for 5 minutes
Circuit breaker litmus: apply synthetic spike to primary to confirm circuit breakers trip at configured thresholds and fallback routes engage
Controlled promotion: promote passive region to active for prioritized traffic classes (admin, write-heavy routes last), use traffic fencing to limit blast radius
KV reconciliation: run incremental KV delta compare; if divergence > 0.5% trigger rollback and alert data-team
Service validation: run smoke suite (auth, token issuance, small-model inference) against promoted region
Post-cutover: verify telemetry ingestion, billing metrics, and per-route latency/cost breakdowns; remove maintenance flag
Rollback criteria: >5% customer-impacting errors OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for >10 minutes => automatic rollback to primary with snapshot rehydration plan
Cleanup: rotate ephemeral credentials used during drill, snapshot the promoted region, and annotate drill ticket with artifacts
test_plan: Unit: run restore-validator unit tests in CI (coverage >= 85%)
Integration: nightly job rehydrates latest backup into staging cluster and runs acceptance checks (KV consistency, token parity)
Chaos: inject network partition between primary and replica during synthetic traffic to confirm graceful degradation and recovery
Load: execute staged soak test up to 150% baseline QPS to validate load-shedding thresholds and circuit-breaker behavior
DR Drill: quarterly live drill with live traffic siphon on low-traffic weekend window; dry-run monthly using simulated traffic
observability_checks: SLO dashboards: region-level p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, request throughput
Health signals: tokenstore lag (ms), KV reconciliation mismatch (%) , snapshot age
Circuit breaker: open/close events with timestamps and triggering rule id
Load shedding: shed rate by route and total rejected requests
Audit logs: promotion events, actor, and config diffs captured in Console
slo_targets: Global p99 latency <= 350ms for read paths during steady-state
Promotion window p99 latency <= 600ms for prioritized routes (up to 10 minutes)
Error rate increase during cutover <= 1.5x baseline for non-prioritized routes
Restore validator must complete full KV parity check within 10 minutes of rehydration
circuit_breaker_policy: Per-route fault budget: open when error rate > 3% for 2m or p95 latency > 2x baseline for 1m
Backoff: exponential backoff probing with initial 30s cooldown and 2x multiplier
Fallback path: when primary breaks, route to passive read replicas or cached responses depending on route classification
Telemetry: each circuit event emits a structured event to the DR dashboard with correlation id
load_shedding_policy: Priority tiers: admin(1), interactive(2), batch(3). Shed starting from tier 3 when system CPU > 70% for 30s
Graceful reject payload includes status 429 and a retry-after with deterministic jitter
Cache-first: for interactive routes, serve from prefix cache up to configured TTL before rejecting
Manual override: on-call can toggle aggressive shedding for non-critical tenants via Console toggle
backup_restore_validation: Automated harness that: finds latest successful snapshot, rehydrates into ephemeral cluster, runs tokenstore + KV + metadata parity checks
Checksums: verify manifest checksums and object storage fingerprints match catalog
Smoke tests: auth token issuance, small model inference, and billing event generation
Failure modes: if any check fails, create incident with priority P0 and prevent region promotion until resolved
Retention tests: verify old snapshots can still be restored (spot-check monthly for rolling 90-day window)
drill_schedule: Monthly targeted dry-run (no live traffic) executed by SRE rotational team
Quarterly partial-cutover weekend drills with 10% live traffic canaries
Annual full promotion drill during maintenance window with post-mortem and executive summary
Ad-hoc drills triggered after any production incident impacting multi-region availability

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: snapshot corruption leading to failed promotion. Mitigation: automated checksum and multi-zone replication of snapshot objects.
Risk: circuit breaker triggers too aggressively during benign spikes. Mitigation: staged traffic canary and adaptive thresholds tied to baseline variance.
Risk: incomplete audit trail for manual promotions. Mitigation: require Console promotion flow and log immutably to audit storage with retention policy.
Risk: long KV reconciliation times causing extended promotion. Mitigation: incremental delta streaming and pre-warm cache for hot keys
